CITY OF SANTA MONICA

  CITY COUNCIL MINUTES

  FEBRUARY 6, 2026

A special meeting of the Santa Monica City Council was called to order by Mayor Torosis at 8:47 a.m., on
Friday, February 6, 2026, at City Council Chambers, 1685 Main Street, Santa Monica, CA.

Roll Call:  Present:  Mayor Caroline Torosis
  Mayor Pro Tern Jesse Zwick
  Councilmember Lana Negrete
  Councilmember Dan Hall
  Councilmember Ellis Raskin
  Councilmember Barry Snell
  Councilmember Natalya Zemitskaya

  Also Present:  City Manager Oliver Chi
  Interim City Attorney Heidi von Tongeln
  Interim City Clerk Denise Anderson-Warren

CONVENE/PLEDGE  On order of the Mayor, the City Council convened at 8:46 a.m., with all
  members present. Councilmember Negrete led the assemblage in the Pledge
  of Allegiance.

STATEMENT OF  The City of Santa Monica Statement of Accountability (Land
ACCOUNTABILITY  Acknowledgement) was read into the record by Mayor Pro Tern Zwick.
(LAND
ACKNOWLEDGEMENT)

LEVINE ACT  No Councilmembers made disclosures regarding the Levine Act (Govt Code
DISCLOSURE  Section 84308).

PUBLIC INPUT FOR  There were no members of the public present to comment on Closed Session
CLOSED SESSION ONLY: items.

CLOSED SESSIONS  On order of the Mayor, the City Council recessed at 8:50 a.m., to consider
  Closed Sessions and returned at 3:49 p.m., to report the following:

  5.A. Public employee appointment - Gov. Code § 54957(b): consider
  public employee appointment; title: City Attorney; Gov. Code §
  54957.6: conference with labor negotiator; City negotiator: Mayor/City
  Manager; unrepresented employee: City Attorney

  The Mayor advised this matter was heard with no reportable action taken.

  February 6, 2026
